q1.question: Is it really free to listen to radio on Rradio?
q1.answer: Yes, Rradio is 100% free. You can listen to all radio stations at no cost, with no time limits and no need to register. Simply choose your favorite station and start listening.

q2.question: Do I need to download anything to listen to radio?
q2.answer: You don't need to download any app. Rradio works directly in your web browser. However, you can also install the progressive web app (PWA) on your device for faster access.

q3.question: How many radio stations are available?
q3.answer: We have over 30,000 radio stations from around the world. We cover all music genres, news, sports, podcasts and more. We constantly add new stations to offer you the best variety.

q4.question: Can I listen to stations from other countries?
q4.answer: Of course! Rradio allows you to listen to stations from over 200 countries. Discover music and culture from around the world, from local radios to the most popular international stations.

q5.question: How do I save my favorite stations?
q5.answer: It's very easy. Just click the heart icon ❤️ on any station to add it to your favorites. You can access them quickly from the 'Favorites' section in the navigation menu.

intro.title: What is Online Radio?
intro.content:
The **online radio** is much more than an audio streaming service. It's your direct connection to the cultural authenticity of anywhere in the world. While AI-generated playlists offer you predictable music, online radio immerses you in the real experience of being there.

Listening to a local radio from Buenos Aires, Tokyo, or Paris instantly transports you. You hear the same ads as locals, the same breaking news, the same DJ that accompanies millions in their daily routine. **It's not just music, it's real-time human connection**.

benefits.title: Why Online Radio Beats AI Playlists

authenticity.title: 🌍 Real Cultural Authenticity
authenticity.description: No algorithms. Listen to what really plays on the streets of Madrid, New York, or Tokyo. Connect with local culture authentically.

human.title: 🎙️ Human Content, Not Robots
human.description: Real DJs, passionate hosts, live debates. Online radio connects you with people, not cold algorithms.

discovery.title: 📻 Genuine Discovery
discovery.description: Find music you would never search for. Local DJs introduce you to emerging artists before Spotify or YouTube.

free.title: 🆓 100% Free, Unlimited
free.description: Unlike premium streaming services, online radio is completely free. No subscriptions, no invasive ads.

how.title: How Online Radio Works
how.content:
The technology behind online radio is surprisingly simple yet powerful. Stations broadcast their audio signal over the internet using streaming protocols like HLS, Icecast, or Shoutcast.

**Technical advantages:**
- Superior audio quality (up to 320kbps, better than FM)
- No interference or static noise
- Global access from any device
- Compatible with modern browsers, no apps needed

All you need is an internet connection and the desire to explore the world through sound.

cultural.title: Radio as a Cultural Bridge
cultural.content:
At Rradio, we believe online radio is the most authentic way to experience a foreign culture without leaving home.

**Real use cases:**

- **Language learning**: Listen to French radio while cooking. It's more effective than any language app because it's real content, not pedagogical scripts.

- **Expats and nostalgia**: Thousands of users listen to radio from their home country to feel closer. The familiar accent, local news, the music you grew up with.

- **Virtual travelers**: Plan your next trip by listening to local radio. Discover what music is trending, what events are being discussed, how that place really sounds.

Online radio doesn't just transmit audio, it transmits **atmosphere, emotion, and culture in its purest form**.

free.a: Yes, 100% free. Unlike Spotify or Apple Music, online radio doesn't require a premium subscription. Stations are funded by local advertising, not your money.

countries.q: Can I listen to radio from other countries?
countries.a: Of course! That's the magic of online radio. Listen to stations from over 200 countries. No borders, no restrictions.

spotify.q: What's the difference between online radio and Spotify?
spotify.a: Spotify uses algorithms to create personalized playlists. Online radio connects you with real human content: DJs, live news, local events. It's the difference between a restaurant with a chef and a microwave.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Rradio we value and respect your privacy. This policy explains what information is processed when you use our online radio service, why, and what choices you have.

collection.title: 1. Information We Collect
collection.content:
Rradio has no user accounts or sign-up forms, so we never ask for your name, email or password.

**Automatic technical data:** like any website, our hosting provider (Vercel) receives your IP address, browser type and the pages you visit in order to serve the site and protect it from abuse. We also measure page performance with Vercel Speed Insights, which records speed metrics in aggregate and without cookies.

**Data stored on your device:** your favorite stations and your language are stored in your own browser (local storage and a language cookie). They are not sent to our servers.

**If you write to us:** if you contact us by email, we use your address and message only to reply to you.

usage.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
usage.content:
We use the information above to:

- Serve the site and play the stations you choose
- Remember your language and favorites on your device
- Detect and block abusive use of the service
- Measure and improve site speed
- Show advertising through Google AdSense (see section 3)
- Answer your inquiries and meet legal obligations

advertising.title: 3. Advertising and Google AdSense
advertising.content:
Rradio is funded by **Google AdSense** advertising. Google and its partners may use cookies and identifiers to show ads, limit how often you see the same ad and measure ad performance. Ads may be personalized based on your interests or non-personalized, depending on your choice.

**Consent:** if you visit Rradio from the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, you will see a Google consent message where you can accept or reject the use of your data for advertising, and change your choice later. Without your consent, only non-personalized or limited ads are shown.

Learn more: [How Google uses information from sites that use its services](https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites). You can turn off personalized ads in [Google Ads Settings](https://adssettings.google.com/).

cookies.title: 4. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.content:
**Necessary (first-party):** a cookie that remembers your language and your browser's local storage, where your favorites and preferences are kept. They are not used for tracking.

**Advertising (Google):** Google AdSense cookies to show and measure ads, subject to your consent where the law requires it.

We do not use Google Analytics or any other cookie-based analytics. You can delete cookies and local storage in your browser settings; if you do, your favorites will be lost.

sharing.title: 5. Third-Party Services
sharing.content:
We do not sell your personal information. To work, Rradio relies on these third parties:

- **Radio stations:** audio is played directly from each station's server, which receives your IP address as with any internet stream. Each station has its own privacy policy.
- **Radio Browser:** the public station directory our catalog comes from. When you play a station, we anonymously report the play for its popularity ranking.
- **Vercel:** site hosting and performance metrics.
- **Google AdSense:** advertising (see section 3).

rights.title: 6. Your Rights (GDPR/CCPA)
rights.content:
Depending on the law in your country, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your data, object to its processing, request portability and withdraw your consent at any time.

Since we have no user accounts, most data about you lives in your own browser and you can delete it yourself. For advertising, you can change your choice in Google's consent message or in Google Ads Settings.

For any other request, write to **contact@rradio.online**.

children.title: 7. Children's Privacy (COPPA)
children.content: Our service is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect information from children. If you believe a child has sent us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

security.title: 8. Data Security
security.content: The whole site runs over HTTPS and we only play stations that stream over secure connections. We rate-limit automated requests to protect the service and we do not store personal data in databases of our own. Even so, no system is 100% secure.

international.title: 9. International Transfers
international.content: Our providers may process data on servers outside your country of residence, including the United States and the European Union. These providers apply the safeguards required by the applicable data protection laws.

changes.title: 10. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this policy when the service or the law changes. We will publish changes on this page and update the "Last updated" date.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.content:
If you have questions about this privacy policy or want to exercise your rights, contact us:

**Email:** contact@rradio.online

We will answer your request within 30 days.

about.title: About Rradio
about.subtitle: Your window to the world through online radio

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content:
We believe online radio is the most authentic way to connect with cultures around the world. Unlike algorithm-generated playlists, radio brings you real human content: passionate DJs, live news and the genuine atmosphere of each place.

Our mission is to make more than 30,000 radio stations from around the world accessible for free, without barriers or unnecessary downloads.

story.title: Our Story
story.content:
Rradio was born out of nostalgia. As expatriates, we wanted to stay connected to our roots by listening to the same stations as our friends and family.

We realized there were thousands of great stations on the internet, but they were scattered and hard to find. That is how Rradio was born: a platform that gathers and organizes radio stations from around the world in one place.

technology.title: Technology
technology.content:
Rradio is a modern, lightweight web app:

- **Next.js and React** so the site loads fast and can be installed as an app (PWA) on your phone or computer
- **Radio Browser**, the public, community-run station directory, as the source of our catalog
- **Direct playback** from each station's server, over secure connections (HTTPS) only
- **Responsive design** that works on mobile, tablet and desktop

Audio quality depends on each station: most stream between 64 and 320 kbps in MP3, AAC or Ogg.

team.title: The Project
team.content:
Rradio is an independent project, built and maintained by a single developer who loves radio. There is no big company behind it: every feature, text and fix is done by me.

If you find a bug, a station that does not work or want to suggest an improvement, write to contact@rradio.online. I read every message.
